shape.description: Both entries bare divs; the CURRENT one carries the inverted --disabled marker.

page.note: Both entries are inert by construction, so no pass can single one out and the picker must ABSTAIN (pre-fix it returned the first in DOM order, 'ru'). Detection then falls through to <html lang="uk">, the page is not blocked, and the ladder stands down. The URL carries ?tab= on purpose: the uk-UA alternate is canonical and query-less, so a navigation here is exactly the reported damage.
